name: Pixel Art Redmond, local Klein 9B pilot (Linux CUDA, diffusers bf16)
status: Same base model family, adapter, scale, steps, guidance and seed as the bundled preset; bf16 diffusers weights on CUDA instead of the MLX q4 build, so pixels differ from the Mac runtime
note: Native 1024-square edits through the source/cuda-imagine queue on Linux with an NVIDIA GPU, composed through neighbour-aware context infill for larger maps. No silent reference shrinking, cloud teacher or local training.
materials_rule: The caption names only dominant materials supported by this city source. Rare materials are supplied by source pixels, not global prompt nouns.
large_canvas_route: Neighbour-aware context infill with 1024 native windows and a 128 px overlap feather. This is not shared-latent denoising.
